error.expired: Your KyberNow Admin sign-in has expired (it lasts 12 hours). Go back to the home page and enter the password again.
error.taken: The session was taken over by another device, or stopped from KyberNow Admin.
error.noReply: The Kyber server on {host} is not responding. Check that it is running in KyberNow Admin.
error.noImageStart: Kyber on {host} did not start the picture. Try again in a moment.
error.noImageArrive: {host} is sending the picture, but it is not reaching this browser. Try the H.264 format in Settings › Picture, or use Chrome or Edge.
error.pipeline: The picture from {host} stopped on the computer (capture or encoding), despite {max} restarts. Reconnecting starts it again.
error.unauthorized: Kyber on {host} rejects KyberNow Admin’s token. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, check Kyber in Admin.
error.startFailed: Kyber on {host} could not start the picture. Try again in a moment.
error.decode: This browser cannot decode the picture. Try the H.264 format in Settings › Picture.

notice.displayChanged: The computer’s display changed: the picture is coming back…
notice.imageRestart: The picture stopped on the computer: restarting ({n} of {max})…

mouse.hint: Auto: captured only when a game is full screen on the computer

metrics.title: Statistics
metrics.waiting: Measurements arrive with the first few seconds of picture.
metrics.browserNote: In a browser, display waits for the screen refresh: expect a little more than in the KyberNow Link app.

touch.guideTrackpad: Slide to move the pointer, tap to click, tap with two fingers to right-click. Slide with two fingers to scroll.
touch.guideDirect: Tap to click where your finger is, touch and hold to right-click. Slide with two fingers to scroll.

app.noPassword: KyberNow Admin does not have a password on this computer yet.

gate.title: Open your computer in this browser.
gate.lead: Enter the KyberNow Admin password, chosen during installation.
gate.hint: There is nothing to install. The connection is encrypted with this computer’s certificate.

home.live: In session on {name}: connecting will end it
home.blockedIsolation: The page could not isolate itself, which the picture needs. Reload it; if this persists, update KyberNow Station.
home.blockedEngine: The computer's Kyber server is not responding. Check that it is running in Admin.
home.displaysAsIs: The computer's own displays, as they are
home.displaySized: {width} × {height} display at {refresh} Hz, sized for this screen

settings.title: Settings for {name}
settings.fullscreenSub: The picture fills the screen as soon as you connect.
settings.bitrateAuto: Based on the profile and the display size
settings.clipboardSub: The browser asks for permission once.
settings.mouseAuto: Captured only when a game is full screen on the computer. Ctrl + Alt + Shift releases it.
settings.mouseGame: Captured: raw movement, for aiming. Ctrl + Alt + Shift releases it.
settings.mouseDesktop: Always free: the pointer goes where you put it.
settings.trackpadDesc: Like a laptop’s: precise, for small text.
settings.directDesc: Your finger is the mouse: fast, for big buttons.
settings.pathTouch: WebSocket on this touch device: typed text and finger position go through this connection (a little more latency).
settings.pathWebkit: WebSocket in Safari: its WebTransport cannot verify the computer’s certificate (a little more latency).
settings.pathFirefox: WebSocket in Firefox, with H.264 in Auto: the combination chosen for this browser (a little more latency).
settings.pathUnsupported: WebSocket: this browser does not have WebTransport (a little more latency).
settings.pathDirect: WebTransport, direct; if the picture does not arrive within 12 s of the computer starting it (25 s after connecting if it does not start it), the page switches to WebSocket.
settings.formatAuto: Auto: HEVC when this device's graphics card decodes it, H.264 otherwise.
settings.virtualHelp: The computer creates a display sized for this device during the session; its own displays switch off, then come back at the end.
settings.virtualMissing: This computer cannot create a virtual display: the session shows its own displays as they are.
settings.barShortcut: Ctrl + Alt + Shift shows the session bar and releases the mouse. System shortcuts are in the bar's Keys menu.
settings.transportHelp: Fast suits your home network and gaming. Reliable resends what gets lost, at the cost of a little delay.
settings.transportAuto: Auto: Reliable with the Desktop profile, Fast with Game and Max.
settings.rotate: The computer then creates a display at its size, in landscape.
settings.homeScreenTitle: Add this page to your Home Screen.
settings.homeScreen: It then opens full screen, without the browser bar.

profile.maxNote: The best picture this device can show.

stats.help: The delay between the computer and this screen. Below a mark, the picture arrives before the next frame at that refresh rate.
stats.none: No session on this computer yet.

browser.title: This browser
browser.hardware: Picture decoded by the graphics card
browser.websocket: Picture over WebSocket: a little more latency than WebTransport
browser.keysMenu: System shortcuts from the Keys menu
browser.text444Missing: Sharp text (4:4:4): not in this browser

station.adminHelp: Admin opens in this browser, without asking for the password again.
station.restartHelp: About 30 seconds. A session in progress will be cut off.
station.updateHelp: Version {version}. About a minute. A session in progress will be cut off.
station.requiresSetup: Version {version} installs on the computer, with KyberNow-Station-Setup.exe.
station.cutRestart: Restarting the Station will end its session.
station.cutUpdate: The update will end its session.
station.tooSoon: The Station has just restarted. Try again in a minute.
station.tooOld: To restart or update the Station from this device, first update it from Admin.
station.signOutHelp: This browser will ask you for the Admin password again.
station.slow: The Station is taking a while to come back. Open Admin to find out more.
station.updateFailed: The update did not complete. Open Admin to find out more.

app.restartDone: The server restarted with the new settings.
app.accessRestartDone: The server restarted: access is up to date.
app.pendingAccess: Server restart pending to {reason}: it will happen on its own as soon as the current session ends, without cutting anyone off. To skip the wait, restart now (the connected device will be disconnected for a few seconds).
app.settingsChanged: Settings changed: restart the server to apply them. A connected device will be disconnected for a few seconds.
app.pairAsks: {name} is asking for access to this computer, with the code

login.signInIntro: The Admin password, chosen during installation.
login.codeIntro: The code proves you are at this computer, or have access to it.
login.codeHint: On the computer: the KyberNow Station tray icon menu, or the file {file}
login.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
login.forgotHelp: On the computer, KyberNow Station tray icon menu › Reset the Admin password. Your devices and their accounts stay as they are.
login.foot: Connection encrypted with this computer’s certificate.

overview.confirmCut: Cut the current connection? The server restarts, for a few seconds.

audio.readySub: Up to 7.1, the computer stays silent

overview.lastSession: Nobody is connected. Last session: {name}, {when}, for {duration}.
overview.noEvents: Nothing yet: connections and changes will show up here.

devices.acceptedRestarting: {name} now has access. The server restarts for a few seconds to apply it.
devices.acceptedWaiting: {name} now has access. A session is in progress: the server will restart on its own as soon as it ends, and {name} can then connect.
devices.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the link by hand.
devices.confirmRevoke: Remove access for {name}? Its own account ({user}) is deleted: to come back, it will have to be paired again.
devices.confirmForget: Forget {name}? It can still connect with its account; it only disappears from this list.
devices.revokedLater: Access removed for {name}. The server will restart to apply it as soon as the current session ends.
devices.eyebrow: The devices that open this computer
devices.title: Link devices
devices.intro: The KyberNow Link apps that open this computer, and what happens when they connect. Usernames and passwords are under

add.title: Add a device
add.text: On your network, open KyberNow Link: this computer is already there. Elsewhere, or over a VPN, scan this code with the device, or paste the pairing link into the app.
add.explain: This computer’s address and its certificate fingerprint: the app knows it is talking to the right computer. No password.

list.title: Your devices
list.sub: Those that have already connected, and what happens when they arrive.
list.oneAtATime: one in session at a time
list.requestHelp: Accept only if this code is the one shown on your device. It gets its own access, which you can remove here.
list.empty: No device has connected yet. KyberNow Link apps show up here after their first session.

card.launchText: An app opens on the computer as soon as the virtual display is ready, with your Windows account. Already open, it comes back to the front.
card.closeAtEnd: Close the app at the end of the session
card.closeAtEndHint: By its own means (Big Picture), otherwise by closing its windows
card.cannotClose: This app cannot be closed cleanly
card.skipDesktopHint: Nothing opens when the device connects for the desktop
card.ownAccessText: Own account {user}, received with a code {when}. Removing it cuts this device's access only; people's accounts, under Users, do not change.
card.accountText: Connects with the account {user}, entered in the app. Its password is changed under Users.

launch.title: When {name} connects
launch.intro: An app opens on the computer as soon as its display is ready: Steam Big Picture, Playnite, a spreadsheet… Apps and their icons come from the computer’s Start menu.
launch.otherHint: An executable or a shortcut in Program Files, on the Desktop or in the user’s apps
launch.readFailed: The Start menu could not be read again: {error}. Sign in to Windows on the computer, then refresh.
launch.emptyCatalogue: No app found. Sign in to Windows on the computer, then refresh.
launch.noneHint: Nothing opens at the start of the session
launch.saved: {app} will open at the start of {name}’s sessions
launch.cleared: Nothing opens at the start of {name}’s sessions any more
launch.closeHint: Can close by itself at the end of the session.
launch.optionsHint: The other options are on the device's card.

users.title: Users
users.intro: The username and password entered in KyberNow Link. A device accepted with a code has its own access: it is managed from its card under

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.sub: One username per person. Several devices can use the same one.
accounts.insecure: The sample account “{user}” still has its original password
accounts.insecureHint: It is known to everyone. Change it or delete it.
accounts.unused: No device uses it yet: enter it in KyberNow Link.
accounts.deviceText: Created when {device} was accepted with a code. No password to remember: the device carries it.
accounts.passwordHint: The devices that use it will have to enter it again.

add.title: Add a person
add.sub: They will enter this username and password in KyberNow Link, on the device of their choice.
add.hash: Kyber only keeps a hash of passwords (SHA-256). An added or changed account applies when the server restarts, which Admin offers right away.

users.accountExists: “{user}” already exists: change its password instead.
users.removeDeviceConsequence: {device} will no longer be able to connect.
users.removeConsequence: Devices that use it will no longer be able to connect.

system.title: System
system.intro: Updates, the server and graphics card, logs, and Kyber’s fine-tuning settings.

update.title: Updates
update.confirmRollback: Go back to KyberNow Station {version}? The Station restarts, which takes about a minute.
update.timeout: The update did not complete within 5 minutes: see C:\ProgramData\KyberNow\update\<version>\update.log.
update.installingLead: The Station stops, replaces its files and comes back on its own in about a minute. This page reloads by itself.
update.installHint: About a minute. A session in progress will be cut off. You have {current}.
update.needsSetup: This version is installed with the installer.
update.refused: Package rejected, nothing was installed. You have {current}.
update.latest: KyberNow Station {version} is the latest version.
update.latestJustNow: KyberNow Station {version} is the latest version · checked just now.
update.latestMinutes: KyberNow Station {version} is the latest version · checked {n} min ago.
update.rollback: Go back to the previous version ({version})

server.title: Server
server.confirmStop: Stop the server? No device will be able to connect until it restarts.
server.trayNote: The KyberNow Station tray icon is set from its own menu (start with the computer).

station.restartHint: Restarts the streaming engine and Admin, in about 30 seconds. A session in progress will be cut off.
station.restartingLead: The server and Admin stop and start again, in about a minute. This page comes back by itself, then Admin asks you to sign in again.
station.timeout: The Station did not restart within 3 minutes: see C:\ProgramData\KyberNow\station\redemarrage.log.

wake.title: Wake on LAN
wake.allowedHelp: Windows lets this card turn the computer on while it is asleep. Your devices can wake it from the KyberNow Link app. After a full shutdown, the BIOS must allow it too.
wake.notAllowedHelp: To let your devices turn this computer on, allow wake on magic packet in the network card’s properties, and in the BIOS.
wake.unknownHelp: Windows doesn’t say whether this card can turn the computer on. To let your devices do it, allow wake on magic packet in the network card’s properties, and in the BIOS.
wake.noneHelp: Waking goes through an Ethernet or Wi-Fi card connected to the local network. This computer has none in use.
wake.wifiHelp: Over Wi-Fi, waking only works with some cards, and only from sleep. An Ethernet cable is more reliable.

logs.title: Logs
logs.levelHelp: Normal is enough day to day. Use Detailed while you track down a problem: logs grow quickly.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: Kyber’s own settings. The defaults almost always work; a wrong setting can keep devices from connecting.
advanced.portHelp: Picked at random during installation. Changing it means adding the computer again on your devices, and opening the new port in the firewall.
advanced.confirmPort: Change the stream port? Your devices will have to add this computer again.
advanced.configHelp: kyber_config.toml, live. The syntax is checked before saving, not the meaning of the values.

lang.title: Admin language
lang.help: Auto follows this browser’s language. The choice applies to this browser, in Admin as in KyberNow Link web.

password.title: Admin password
password.help: The one chosen during installation. Changing it signs out the other open sessions.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.changed: Admin password changed. The other sessions have been signed out.

imageSound.title: Picture and sound
imageSound.intro: What your devices receive, and what happens to this computer during a session. The KyberNow Link apps set the picture quality themselves: there is nothing to set here to get started.

channels.autoHint: Auto follows what the device’s output accepts. A device with fewer channels downmixes on its own.
channels.stereoHint: Always two channels, whatever the device.
channels.surround51Hint: Six channels, even if the device asks for nothing: surround games and films place each sound.
channels.surround71Hint: Eight channels, even if the device asks for nothing.

inputNotes.gamepad: The KyberNow Link apps choose for themselves, per computer (the “Gamepad seen by the computer” setting, or “Controllers seen as Xbox 360” on LG TVs): this is only the default for other connections.

pill.simulated: Simulated: Admin is not running on Windows

display.title: Virtual display
display.sub: A display the exact size of the device that connects.
display.step1Text: The virtual display takes the device’s resolution and refresh rate.
display.step2Text: The connected displays turn off: nobody sees what you are doing.
display.step3Text: Your displays come back, with their usual layout.
display.trigger: When to create the virtual display
display.triggerHelp: The KyberNow Link apps announce their display; a browser or a command-line client does not, so it gets the default mode.
display.defaultModeHelp: For connections that do not announce their display.
display.modeChange: If a game changes the resolution
display.modeChangeHelp: Let it be: the picture follows the game. Put it back: the display returns to the device’s size. The apps choose according to their profile (Game: let it be, Desktop: put it back); this choice applies to the others. With the libavconv engine, a resolution change can cut the picture.
display.failsafeHelp: The driver removes the virtual display on its own when it stops getting signs of life, and Windows turns your displays back on. You can also do it right away.
display.failsafeHelpSeconds: The driver removes the virtual display on its own after {s} s without signs of life, and Windows turns your displays back on. You can also do it right away.

sound.title: Sound
sound.sub: The computer goes quiet and your device gets the sound, from stereo to 7.1.
sound.installSteam: Install Steam on this computer, then run the KyberNow Station installer again: it will add the virtual speakers. Without them, the sound also comes out of the computer’s speakers.
sound.triggerHelp: Otherwise, the sound comes out of the computer’s speakers as usual.

inputs.title: Keyboard, mouse and gamepads
inputs.sub: What goes from your device to this computer.

aside.before: The encoder, capture engine and minimum bitrate are in

share.startHelp: Show one of this computer's screens to someone on your network: they see it, hear the sound, and can play if you let them. You keep using the computer as usual.
share.off: Sharing is turned off on this computer (Admin › Link devices).
share.inSession: {name} is in a session: share from that device.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the link by hand.
share.help: On the same network: “Join with a code” in KyberNow Link, or this link in a browser.

bar.tooOld: Sharing needs KyberNow Station 0.8.0 or later.

join.title: Join a share
join.lead: The code is shown by the person sharing.
join.name: Your name
join.noShare: No share with this code on your network.
join.full: This share is full (four guests at most).
join.tooMany: Too many code attempts: try again in a minute.
join.unreadable: This device cannot play this computer's picture ({format}).
join.unavailable: Sharing is not available right now: try again in a moment.
join.badRequest: The code has six digits, and the name cannot be empty.

quality.title: Picture quality
quality.failed: The picture quality could not be changed: try again.

guest.canPlay: You can play with a controller.
guest.gotKbm: You have the keyboard and mouse.
guest.lostKbm: The keyboard and mouse were taken back.
guest.unauthorized: Kyber on {host} refuses the share's token. Join again with the code.
guest.noImage: {host} is sending the picture, but it does not reach this browser. Try Chrome or Edge.
guest.noMoreImage: The computer can't make another picture: you get {quality}.
